SK Annual Tax Report (Hlásenie)

The employer's annual report on employment income, withheld tax advances and the child tax bonus, with one annex column per employee, generated from the year's payslips as XML for the Slovak financial administration.

Version19.0.2.1.1
EditionCommunity and Enterprise
LicenceAGPL-3
Requiresl10n_cssk_payroll_declaration_base, l10n_sk_base

What it is for

After the end of each year a Slovak employer that withholds income tax files the Hlásenie o vyúčtovaní dane a o úhrne príjmov zo závislej činnosti (report on the tax settlement and total employment income) with its tax office. It sums up the year's wages, withheld tax advances and child tax bonuses, and lists every employee with their own figures.

This module builds the report from the payslips of the calendar year and exports it as XML in the Finančná správa's format. Like its monthly counterpart, l10n_sk_hr_payroll_monthly_tax_overview, it works with either payroll engine (see the Slovak payroll family), and it shares its screens, states and XML checks with the other payroll returns through l10n_cssk_payroll_declaration_base.

Legal background

References are to the Income Tax Act (zákon o dani z príjmov). Statutory terms are given in Slovak.

  • The obligation. An employer that is a platiteľ dane submits a hlásenie on the tax settlement and the total employment income provided to individual employees in the past tax period, on the withheld advances, the zamestnanecká prémia, the daňový bonus and the daňový bonus na zaplatené úroky — § 39 ods. 9 písm. b). The same provision requires each employee's name, surname and birth number (rodné číslo) — which is why the module refuses to generate the report for an employee without one.
  • The deadline. The hlásenie is filed by the end of April after the end of the tax period — § 49 ods. 2. The report for 2026 is due by 30 April 2027.

Setting it up

  • DIČ of the company. Fill in DIČ (the 10-digit tax identification number) on the company; generation stops with an error without it.
  • Company address, phone and e-mail go into the header. The house number is taken from the end of Street (Hlavná 12, Hlavná 1141/11); Street2 is used only when it holds nothing but a number — a building, a floor or a c/o line there is never filed as the house number.
  • Every employee needs a birth number. Enter it, 9 or 10 digits, in Identification No on the Personal tab of the employee form. Slashes and spaces are ignored.
  • Employee names and addresses. The annex takes the employee's private street (its house number split off the same way), ZIP and city. The last word of the name is the surname and everything before it the first name, so record names as "Ján Peter Novák", not "Novák Ján". With hr_employee_firstname installed, its separate first and last name fields are used instead.
  • The form vintage Annual tax reconciliation statement 2023+ (the HLASENIEv23 schema, valid from 1 January 2023) is installed with the module and selected automatically.

Filing a year

Payroll Declarations → SK annual tax reconciliation statement, then New.

  1. Choose the Year. The period is always 1 January to 31 December.
  2. Leave Correction Type on Regular for the ordinary filing.
  3. Click Generate. The module collects every non-cancelled payslip of the company whose period lies in the year — confirmed payslips only — builds one annex column per employee, renders the XML and validates it against the official schema rh2023.xsd. If an employee lacks a birth number, the error names them and nothing is generated.
  4. Download the XML from Xml Attachment and upload it to the Finančná správa portal yourself.
  5. Click Mark Submitted once filed; the filed copy is kept and the record locked. Reset to Draft unlocks it.

Annex mapping and verified scope

Version 19.0.2.1.0, 7 November 2026. Uses the bundled, unchanged rh2023 XSD. This is not certification of a later form edition or acceptance by the authority.

Part IV reports this employer's income for employees without employer annual reconciliation (RZD). Part V reports annual reconciliation data, including all employers' income separately from this employer's contribution. Its r4a/r4b are employee social/health insurance; withheld advance belongs to r6. The old export sent every employee to Part V and placed advance tax in r4a.

The country report remains engine-neutral. _annual_settlement_column(line) is the engine bridge: return None for Part IV, or reviewed Part V values using the QWeb column keys and completed_on (DD.MM.YYYY). If an installed engine exposes a computed/posted RZD but has no bridge, export stops. Completion of RZD is distinct from subsequent payment of its balance. Foreign residence and child bonus without full child identity/entitlement-month data are explicit open adapters, never silently omitted.

Part IV month flags use the selected payroll intervals and historical versions. Date-of-payment/tax-year selection must be supplied by the applicable payroll adapter; this patch does not claim that a payslip date alone proves payment. Parts IV/V have independent employee/page counts and odd-column padding.

Legal mapping: Finančná správa HLASENIEv23 instructions, Parts IV and V: https://pfseform.financnasprava.sk/Formulare/Poucenia/HLASENIEv23-poucenie.pdf

Tests exercise native OCA payroll, XML/XSD, independent sections, proper row meanings and the explicit missing-information guards. Enterprise runtime is not claimed tested by an OCA run. The general bridge regression supplies a reviewed adapter fixture; production annual calculation belongs to the engine bridge.

Corrections

The report accepts riadne, opravné and dodatočné filings. Set Correction Type to Corrective or Supplementary. The module refuses an amending report unless a regular one is already marked submitted — but see Limitations: it currently looks for that original in the same month in which the new record was created.

Form edition cutoff

Version 19.0.2.1.1 limits rh2023 / HLASENIEv23 to tax years through 2025, including an upgrade migration for existing version records. Export for 2026+ is rejected. The Ministry's 2026 form changes Part V row meanings; a successful old XSD check cannot prove compliance with the new form. Install a reviewed current form adapter before filing. This module does not yet supply that adapter.

Without additional bridges, the exporter currently supports only employees for whom this employer did not perform RZD and who received no child bonus, for tax years through 2025. Known RZD requires a Part V bridge; any child bonus requires a child-identity/month bridge and annex renderer. Thus most real employers need additional adapters even for corrective/supplementary historical filings.

Source: https://www.mfsr.sk/files/archiv/75/HLASENIEv26-v1.2.pdf

Child entitlement engine bridge

_annual_child_bonus_details(line, bonus) extends the actual Part IV employee column. An entitlement engine can supply reviewed child identities and months without copying the income/insurance/advance calculation. Its result is merged into that column; it must also provide its reviewed output adapter for child annexes. The default implementation still refuses a nonzero bonus without child evidence. This extension point does not supply an entitlement calculator or a new statutory form edition. Isolated module tests: 17 passing, including the unchanged refusal and a bridge through the real employee-column method.
